dedupe_keys.name: hourly results of the fepps model for great britain future power system by 2030 and 2040

description: Karla Guerra and collaborators at Universidad de Sevilla, the University of Manchester and Universidad de las Americas publish hourly results from the FEPPS model for Great Britain. The data represent future electricity-system scenarios for 2030 and 2040 and accompany the Data in Brief article on systems with high renewable-energy penetration. Harvard Dataverse lists a single Excel workbook, HOURLY RESULTS FEPPS_GB.xlsx, in the public deposit. CC0 1.0 permits free reuse. The repository API returned the named dataset and its file metadata, while the HTML landing page returned an empty HTTP 202 response. The workbook was not downloaded, and the repository description does not enumerate its variables, scenario definitions or spatial resolution below Great Britain. These limits need checking before comparing dispatch or storage outcomes. As a reviewer-assessed application, the hourly results offer a benchmark for scenarios built with model-pypsa. The deposit is recorded as model-output data; executable FEPPS software was not established here.
